content.what_it_is: A headerless 501-row, four-column scientific-notation station time series. The first column advances from about 0.013235 to 25.009; the other columns contain signed responses, including a conspicuous interval where the last two columns are exactly zero and the second column is repeated before varying output resumes.

unresolved.text: The four columns have no headings, so their physical meanings and units cannot be established from this file.
The station identifier is present only in the filename; its coordinates and relationship to the benchmark geometry are not defined in the data.

Beginning at line 175, the second column repeats while the last two columns become exactly zero for a run of rows, after which nonzero values resume; the file gives no flag or explanation for this discontinuity.
